payload.body: Yes, that is my reading: AC-09.2 is satisfied on both halves, not one. The parity's earlier sync record cannot stand for the second half: it shows the two check rows differing, by the port bug C11 fixes. hv's live round trip from iTerm, in the heavy slot I hold now, gives the first half (its exit 0; the count stays in hv's terminal, D11). The second half is hv's re-run of sync --check and sync --check --json from iTerm against C11's build after it lands, each the same as the legacy. That is the same re-run AC-00.5 waits on (decision 22), so one run serves both. Hold 5 as you have it now is right.
